composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, the rack centered and spanning about 80% of the frame width with even margins (at least 10% on every side). The rack is WIDE and SHALLOW — a long low object, roughly three times wider than it is deep — so its four grooves are seen clearly from above-front and run horizontally across the full width of the rack. The rack is completely EMPTY. No table, no cloth, no shadow plate: the rack sits alone on a flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop (the pipeline removes the white afterwards). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadow only inside the grooves. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, bright but not neon.
forbidden_objects: attribute marks, icons, badges, symbols, labels, scale marks or tick marks
balls, beads, counters, markers or anything resting in the grooves
a chart, graph, bar meter, progress bar or any diagram-like flat graphic
wires, rods or strings across the frame
table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the rack
background: flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the rack. A white backdrop is CORRECT and expected: the pipeline keys the white out afterwards. Do NOT attempt to output an alpha channel, and never draw a transparency checkerboard.
purpose: こんだてPLAY の状態 cue に使う「空の木の道具」そのものの master asset（純粋な visual）。粒・目盛り・数字・机・人物は仕様として意図的に描かない — 粒は実行時に UI 層がこの画像の上に重ねる。溝が空であること・机や背景がないことは欠陥ではなく要件。背景は生成時点では平らな純白 #FFFFFF でよく、後段の asset-postprocess が白を抜いて透過 PNG にするので、白背景であることは不具合ではない（他の承認済み素材もすべて同じ経路）。求めるのは、4 本の溝と溝ごとの中央の深いくぼみが一目で分かる、手作りの木の道具に見えること
scene: a wide, shallow counting rack made of warm beige clay-wood, like a simple abacus frame or a wooden tray of grooves, standing on a low rim so it reads as a real physical object resting on a table. FOUR parallel horizontal grooves are carved into its top surface, evenly spaced one above the other, each groove running the full width of the rack; every groove is a smooth shallow channel that a small ball could roll along. In the MIDDLE of each of the four grooves the channel is carved noticeably DEEPER and slightly WIDER — a clearly visible rounded resting hollow at the centre of every groove, with a distinctly darker warm-brown soft shadow pooled inside it — clearly darker than anywhere else on the rack — so it reads unmistakably as a real deep dent that is obviously deeper than the shallower ends of the same groove. The rack is EMPTY: nothing rests in the grooves. The material is the SAME matte hand-pressed clay as the cream lunch tray and the open lunch box — warm honey-beige and cream clay-wood with visible soft thumb-smoothed surface and gentle hand-painted wood-grain streaks running along the length of the rack, the rim a slightly deeper warm brown than the top face so the object reads as a wooden tool, never smooth plastic, never sandy foam, never varnished furniture wood. Soft rounded edges, handmade toy feeling. Series: JIBUN CHOICE 給食 こんだてPLAY, same camera, lighting and clay material as the dish set and the cream lunch tray.
required_objects: one wide shallow wooden clay rack seen from above-front
exactly four parallel horizontal grooves running the full width, evenly spaced
a visibly deeper and slightly wider resting hollow at the centre of each of the four grooves
completely empty grooves with no balls or markers
